filing_office: Montana Secretary of State, Business & UCC Services
filing_fee_notes: Ordinary domestic LLC base fee. A series LLC adds 50 for each series member named.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a person or company with a physical Montana address, not a P.O. box, available during business hours.
expedite_options: Additional processing fees: 20 for 24-hour service or 100 for one-hour service.
annual_report_due: File January 1 through April 15 for the fee waiver. The SOS help page lists December 1 as the domestic filing cutoff and November 1 for foreign entities.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Montana Department of Labor & Industry, Unemployment Insurance Division
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and an annual report. The report fee is waived when you file by April 15.
common_mistake: A waived fee does not remove the annual report requirement.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Annual report fee is 35 after April 15; 0 represents the timely waiver. The report timing field distinguishes the waiver window from the later cutoff stated in the SOS help page. Tax URL covers withholding registration, not every tax account. Standard processing time, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and whether an operating agreement is mandatory were not confirmed.
